mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equities and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain high rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k), the labor market overheats, leading to aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100k, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC over 1-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1250, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Fed's tightening cycle suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
